entries.title: Automatic starts tasks the app picks no model for
entries.body: When the app cannot pick one of your models for a new task, for example when your only model is a custom provider, a task in a project set to Automatic now starts on this computer's default model when it has room, as it does in a project kept on This computer. When no computer has a model that can take the task, it says so instead of waiting for room.

picture.alt: Task Activity for a new task in a project set to Automatic: Automatic chose This computer because it had room, and the crewmate started on this computer's default model.
